	assert(mgr.compute_hash(d3)==hash1)
	print("hash deterministic ok")

	d2.inventory = [i2, i1]
	assert(mgr.compute_hash(d2)!=hash1)
	print("order sensitivity ok")
	
	print("ALL TESTS PASSED")
EOF
